pre_registration.name: roster_continuity
pre_registration.status: pre-registered 2026-10-08, before any fit below (study 3 still running; its result unseen)
pre_registration.motivation: The engine's early-season ratings lean on last season's games, but college rosters turn over: the median team had about 55-60% of last season's minutes back before 2021 and only 26% in 2025-26 (transfer portal), with incoming transfers worth about 20% of a team's minutes. The market's preseason numbers use roster information the engine does not have. Continuity tells the model when last season's ratings deserve less trust (and the forecast more uncertainty).
pre_registration.data: ESPN player box scores via hoopR-mbb-data, commit 13b41edecaf52edc704ef6966eb5ada0bb4167d5 (data/ncaab_players.py)
pre_registration.definition: data/ncaab_continuity.py, point in time: cont = share of the team's minutes last season played by players who have already appeared (minutes > 0) for it this season; xfer = last-season minutes of those players for other teams, as a share of the team's own last-season minutes. Game features: cont_avg and xfer_avg (mean of the two teams), lowcont = 1 - cont_avg, x_pts_lowcont = x_pts x lowcont.

candidates.R1_continuity: locked v3 + mean features [cont_avg, xfer_avg, x_pts_lowcont] + variance feature [lowcont]

pre_registration.selection_rule: as study_2: lower log loss AND higher matched-volume ROI at -110 than the locked engine in BOTH eras
pre_registration.confirmation: as study_2, on the sealed 2021-26 seasons, run once
pre_registration.secondary: early-season games (a team with < 6 games) reported separately; not part of the rule
pre_registration.disclosure: Season-level medians of cont and xfer were looked at (no outcomes). If study 3 also reaches its confirmation, 2021-26 is used twice; both uses are reported.
